name: kevos

scripts.build: node scripts/build-kevos-icons.mjs && astro build && pagefind --site dist && node scripts/postbuild.mjs
scripts.preview: npm run build && npx wrangler dev
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run verify && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.assessment:assets: python scripts/assessment/qr.py && node scripts/assessment/marketing.mjs && node scripts/assessment/report.mjs

description: KEVOS website: Astro static site served by a Cloudflare Worker.
